svg.text: Before a source tile is transformed, a 9 × 9 grid of its points is tried with the checked transform
The tile lies inside the domain:
its vertices go through the unchecked
transform, at half the proj4 cost, and
the grid also gives the segment limit.
The domain's edge crosses the tile.
The test stops at the first such point;
every vertex and midpoint is transformed
checked, and every segment is densified
(no segment limit). Rings that leave are dropped.
